answer: We formalize Sybil resistance through dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect punishment matrices requiring every generated identity to harbor heavy staking collateral. Enforced by zero-knowledge verifiable delay, this cryptographic primitive inverts attacker utility into a steep mesa, guaranteeing that identity proliferation pushes marginal profit to an irrecoverable nadir. The resulting slashing penalties mathematically yield negative expected attack utility, compelling rational agents to converge on a robust Nash equilibrium immune to node duplication.
